answer: An agent marketplace requires each voting identity to lock 100 tokens in escrow for 30 days before its vote counts, and the same tokens cannot back two identities. Whether an agent is named plume, sparrow, or mirror, it gets no free influence from a fresh account. Creating 1,000 voting sybils therefore requires locking 100,000 tokens, tying up capital and exposing the attacker to token-price risk throughout the lockup.
